entities.summary: Claude Ponticelli, known as Claude Ponti, was born on November 22, 1948, in Lunéville. He is a French children’s author and illustrator. His books feature detailed illustrations and imaginative narratives. Several recurring characters, such as Blaise the masked chick, have become recognizable within French children’s literature.
